plugins.description: Turn an approved training programme into a finished course on the NOVIKONTAS Android tablets: the accredited-hours law, ILO immutability, the one-page instructor module, the locked visual system, what representation actually teaches a concept, the asset pipeline with provenance and rights, trainee task screens, and a publisher that separates trainee from instructor material.
